resources.string:
TG Drive is an independent Telegram API client, not an official Telegram product.

Files are uploaded as documents to your own Saved Messages. Only documents with TG Drive metadata appear here. Deleting an original message in Telegram also removes access to that file.

Files and their names are NOT encrypted end to end by this app. Telegram cloud storage rules and account limits apply. Do not use this as the only backup of important files.

Your Telegram session stays on this device. The local database key and manually entered API credentials are protected by Android Keystore. No developer server receives your files or login codes.

Refresh rebuilds the file index from Saved Messages. Empty folders are local only. Signing out or reinstalling may remove local organization and temporary files; uploaded documents remain in Telegram.

Transfers run in a foreground service. If Android kills the process, reopen the app and refresh to check completed uploads before retrying. Automatic backup, public sharing, app lock and additional file encryption are not included in this version.

Stored in your Saved Messages. Telegram limits apply.
Folders with uploaded files can be restored from Telegram. Empty folders stay on this device.
“%1$s” and its original message will be deleted from Telegram Saved Messages. There is no trash or undo.
Your cloud files will stay in Telegram. Finish any transfers before signing out.
A calm space for the files you keep in Saved Messages. Connect your account to get started.
This build has no Telegram API credentials. Create an application at my.telegram.org, then enter its API ID and hash here. These are app credentials, not a bot token.
Use an existing Telegram account. Include your country code, for example +212…
Enter the code sent by Telegram. Check your Telegram app; SMS delivery is not guaranteed.
Your account uses two-step verification. Enter its Telegram password.
